softPlay.introHeading: A soft, styled space to play
softPlay.heroTitle: Soft Play Hire in Johannesburg & Pretoria
softPlay.heroLead: A little space for play. Soft, coordinated play areas that keep children busy and look lovely in the photographs.
softPlay.intro: Soft play gives younger children their own place to explore — climbing, sliding and tumbling on padded shapes while the grown-ups relax nearby. Our all-white setup suits bright, modern celebrations and works in a lounge, a hall or under a marquee.
softPlay.spaceNote: Tell us about your space — indoor, outdoor, or under cover — and the team will confirm what fits and any access or power needs with your quote.

jumpingCastles.introHeading: Room to bounce, space to celebrate
jumpingCastles.heroLead: Room to bounce, space to celebrate. Distinct castle options for children's parties, each priced and described on its own.
jumpingCastles.intro: A jumping castle is the dependable centrepiece of a children's party. We keep our castle options distinct — a classic castle, a white dome with a roof, a bounce house on its own, or a castle paired with a table and chairs — so you can compare like with like.
jumpingCastles.spaceNote: Castle space, access and electricity requirements are confirmed with your quote once we know your venue and suburb.

partyFun.introHeading: A little more fun for the party
partyFun.heroLead: Add a little more fun. Candy carts, popcorn, slush and candy floss to round out the celebration.
partyFun.intro: Party fun is the extra touch that keeps children happily occupied between the big moments. Choose a candy cart, a popcorn, slush or candy floss machine, and build a small treat corner alongside your play setup. Consumables are confirmed with your quote.
partyFun.consumablesNote: Where an option includes consumables, that is named in the item. Other treats and consumables are confirmed with your quote.

packages.heroLead: Choose a setup that brings it together. Kids Party Combos scale with your guest list, combining play and party essentials in one booking.
packages.intro: Packages are the simplest way to cover the essentials at once. Each Kids Party Combo is priced by how many children you're expecting, so you can move up a tier without reorganising the whole celebration. The exact combination of items is confirmed with your quote.
packages.tierLabel: Each tier is priced by the number of children you're expecting.
packages.compareNote: Prices are the approved amounts for each tier. Move between tiers to see how the price changes.

bubbleHouse.heroLead: A rounded, look-at-me inflatable that children love to play inside — styled with balloons to suit your celebration.
bubbleHouse.intro: The bubble house is a large, clear inflatable dome that makes a striking centrepiece. We offer it dressed with 100 balloons, finished with a balloon garland, or as a complete package. Availability is confirmed with your quote, as these setups are arranged per event.

about.heroLead: We help families across Johannesburg, Pretoria and the surrounding service areas plan the play for children's celebrations.
about.approachBody: We keep things simple. You choose the hire, share your date and suburb, and we confirm the details with you directly on WhatsApp. There's no pressure and no hidden assumptions — if something doesn't fit your venue or budget, we'll tell you before you commit.
about.servicesBody: Our core hire covers soft play, jumping castles and party fun, along with packages that bring them together. Alongside that, we coordinate weddings and style wider events, bringing in specialist suppliers where a service sits outside our own equipment.
about.areasBody: We serve Bryanston, the Sandton City area, Randburg, Pretoria, Germiston, Centurion, Midrand and the Johannesburg northern suburbs. Delivery is quoted for your suburb and confirmed before anything is reserved.
about.value1Body: We list what each option includes and how it's priced, and we don't dress up scope you won't actually get.
about.value2Body: Availability, delivery and totals are confirmed by the team — our website never pretends a booking is done.
about.value3Body: One short enquiry gets you a real conversation on WhatsApp, phone or email.
about.ctaHeading: Start with your date and suburb
about.ctaBody: Send a short enquiry and we'll take it from there.

services.heroLead: From all-white luxury tents and monogram backdrops to full planning and day-of coordination — tell us your date and vision and we will craft a tailored proposal.
services.intro: Our broader event services cover coordination and styling for weddings and special occasions. Because some elements sit outside our own equipment, the team, scope and pricing are tailored to your event and confirmed with you directly.
services.packagesLead: Three tailored planning tiers — from full-service guidance to month-of coordination. A 40% retainer secures your date, with flexible milestone payment plans available.
services.offerLead: Three signature offerings, each tailored to your venue, guest count and style — from statement décor to hands-on coordination.
services.styleLead: Real setups from our wedding décor work — white luxury tents, floral monograms and soft blush receptions.
services.availabilityNote: All event services are available by arrangement. Tell us about your occasion and we'll confirm the scope, team and quote.
services.travelNote: For event-service work more than 50 km from our base, an out-of-town travel fee of R4.50 per kilometre applies. This is specific to event services and is not a general party-hire delivery rate — hire delivery is quoted separately for your suburb.

faqs.heading: Party hire questions
faqs.lead: Answers to the questions we're asked most. If something isn't covered, ask us directly — we'd rather confirm than guess.
faqs.ctaBody: Send it through and we'll answer honestly.

how-enquiry.q: How does the enquiry process work?
how-enquiry.a: Choose a hire option, complete the short form with your name, date and suburb, and continue to WhatsApp. You review the prefilled message and send it. The team then confirms availability, delivery and the final total.

is-it-booked.q: Is my event booked once I send the enquiry?
is-it-booked.a: No. Sending an enquiry — or opening WhatsApp — does not reserve a date. Your booking is confirmed only once the team confirms availability and the details with you.

delivery.q: Do you deliver to my area?
delivery.a: We serve Bryanston, the Sandton City area, Randburg, Pretoria, Germiston, Centurion, Midrand and the Johannesburg northern suburbs. Delivery is quoted for your suburb. If you're nearby but not on the list, ask us and we'll check.

price-basis.q: What is included in the price?
price-basis.a: The price shown is the approved amount for that option. What each option includes is described on its page. Delivery, and any consumables not named in the item, are confirmed with your quote.

space.q: How much space do I need?
space.a: Space, access and electricity needs depend on the item and your venue. Share the details in your enquiry and the team will confirm what's required before you commit.

weather.q: What happens if the weather turns?
weather.a: Weather arrangements depend on your setup and venue. Talk to the team when you enquire and they'll explain the options for your date.

setup.q: Do you set up and collect?
setup.a: Setup and collection arrangements are confirmed with your booking and quote. Tell us your venue and timings so these can be included.

suburb.q: My suburb isn't listed — can you still help?
suburb.a: Possibly. Our list covers our main service areas, but we may be able to help nearby. Send your suburb and we'll confirm.

own-equipment.q: Is all the equipment your own?
own-equipment.a: Our core hire covers soft play, jumping castles and party fun. Some wider event services are arranged with specialist suppliers, and we'll always be clear about which is which.

languages.q: Can I enquire in my language?
languages.a: Yes — choose your preferred language and it's included in your enquiry. We'll confirm what we can support for your booking.

booking-lead-time.q: How far in advance should I book?
booking-lead-time.a: Popular dates fill up first, so we recommend enquiring as early as you can. Send your date and suburb and the team will confirm availability for your chosen setup before anything is reserved.

delivery-cost.a: Delivery, setup and collection are quoted for your suburb and confirmed with your booking. Delivery is a separate line from the hire price, and the event-service travel rate does not apply to party hire.

payment.q: How and when do I pay?
payment.a: Payment arrangements are confirmed with your quote. Please don't make any payment until the team has confirmed your booking with you.

power-access.q: Do you need power, a flat surface or vehicle access?
power-access.a: It depends on the setup and your venue. Share your space, surface and access details in the enquiry and the team will confirm what's required, including any electricity needs, before you commit.

age-suitability.q: Which setup suits which age group?
age-suitability.a: Soft play and the ball pit tend to suit younger children, while jumping castles suit older children. Tell us the ages you're expecting and the team will suggest a fit.

day-of.q: What happens on the day of the event?
day-of.a: Setup and collection arrangements, including timings for your venue, are confirmed with your booking. The team will explain exactly what to expect before your date.

combo-contents.q: What's included in a Kids Party Combo?
combo-contents.a: A Kids Party Combo brings the play and party essentials together into one booking, sized by the number of children. The exact combination of items is confirmed with your quote.

privacy.heading: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: This notice explains how we handle information when you enquire through this website.
privacy.enquiryBody: When you complete the enquiry form, the details you enter — your first name, suburb, event date, and any optional notes or callback number — are used to build a WhatsApp message. Those details stay in your browser and are sent to us only when you choose to send the message in WhatsApp.
privacy.whatsappBody: This website does not send your enquiry automatically. The form prepares a message and opens WhatsApp, where you review and send it yourself. WhatsApp's own privacy terms apply to the conversation that follows.
privacy.analyticsBody: If analytics is enabled, we record anonymous interactions such as which service pages are viewed and when an enquiry is started. We do not place your name, notes or phone number into analytics, tracking URLs or logs.
privacy.contactBody: You can ask us about the information you have shared with us, or ask us to remove it, by contacting us using the details below.
privacy.policyNote: This notice describes how the website and enquiry flow currently work. Further business policy details, including any statutory disclosures, are being confirmed and will be added before launch.

terms.heading: Hire terms
terms.lead: The terms below describe the arrangements we can confirm. Specific booking, delivery, payment and cancellation details are being finalised and are confirmed with every quote.
terms.enquiryBody: An enquiry or a WhatsApp message does not reserve a date. A booking is confirmed only once the team confirms availability and the agreed details with you.
terms.deliveryBody: Delivery, setup and collection are quoted for your address and confirmed with your booking. Event-service travel rates do not apply to party hire.
terms.paymentBody: Payment arrangements are confirmed with your quote. Please do not make any payment until the team has confirmed your booking.
terms.cancellationBody: Changes and cancellations are handled directly with the team, under the terms confirmed for your booking.
terms.draftNotice: These terms are a working summary. The full approved hire terms are pending and must be confirmed by the business before launch. Until then, please confirm the details of your booking directly with the team.
